body: Please include a CWE mapping for all ASVS items.

comments.body: I'm looking to get ASVS cross mapping to CWE. Is this still going to be implemented? Thanks!
+1 .Looking to get CWE to ASVS mappings. The documentation says this has already been completed.

+1. The documentation says a mapping to the CWE dictionary should exist, but I can't find it.
Has this idea been abandoned? Could anybody confirm?
@FreeWillaert This is on our short list to address before 4.0
I've put in a call to Twitter. Abhay Bhargav @abhaybhargav will assist with this
@vanderaj I see that some of the items in the `Architecture` section seem to be difficult to find CWEs for, as they are SDLC and process-related. Any suggestions for these items?

@vanderaj, @tghosth there is a section in a few files called `NIST`, which is in the place of `CWE`. Can I remove that? Let me know if that has to be preserved?

Currently, I am adding another CWE column to not mess with that dataset

> @vanderaj I see that some of the items in the `Architecture` section seem to be difficult to find CWEs for, as they are SDLC and process-related. Any suggestions for these items?

Just ignore for now

> @vanderaj, @tghosth there is a section in a few files called `NIST`, which is in the place of `CWE`. Can I remove that? Let me know if that has to be preserved?
> 
> Currently, I am adding another CWE column to not mess with that dataset

go ahead and remove if appropriate

There are only a few chapters left without finalized CWE. I've removed all CWSS columns, and moved CWE to have the same location in all tables, so that in V2 and V3, NIST appears to the right of CWE. If we could have all remaining "tbd" CWEs filled in (or blank if no suitable CWE) by Friday, that would be awesome.

Andrew

Sorry for the delay. I have been snowed in suddenly with some client
engagements. Hoping to sit on this today through friday.

Regards
Abhay Bhargav
